mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.member_status, (m.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS member_deleted, (sa.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS social_account_deleted FROM social_accounts sa JOIN members m ON m.member_id = sa.member_id WHERE sa.provider = #{provider} AND sa.provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO social_accounts ( member_id, provider, provider_user_id, provider_email ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{providerEmail} )
